newsitem.title: GREECE: SBC Warburg/Sigma detail Lavipharm placement.
newsitem.headline: SBC Warburg/Sigma detail Lavipharm placement.

text.p: SBC Warburg and Greek brokerage Sigma Securities jointly carried out the task of raising the exposure of Greek pharmaceuticals and cosmetics firm Lavipharm to international investors on Friday, Sigma Securities corporate finance and marketing director Dimitrios Papadopoulos said.

A total of 1,330,963 Lavipharm shares, representing over 15 percent of its total stock, were placed at 2,500 drachmas mostly with foreign investors, with two local institutional portfolios taking up around 20,000 shares.
SBC Warburg placed over three quarters of the total 1.33 million share block, with Sigma Securities placing 367,000 shares or nearly 28 percent, Papadopoulos said.
The shares were placed ex-rights. Those rights will be fully exercised by Athanasios Lavidas, Lavipharm's main shareholder.
Lavipharm is in the midst of a 4-for-10 rights issue at 1,900 drachmas to raise 6.46 billion drachmas.

Proceeds will be used to complete capital investments for transdermal drug production and storage facilities, to finance research and development of transdermal and osmotic technology and to retire bank debt and finance acquisitions. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
